name: bridgewright
description: Use your local browser from Playwright running in Codespaces.
author: Marcus Markiewicz

bridgewright.defaultRemotePort.description: Preferred Codespace localhost port for the CDP endpoint.

bridgewright.tunnelPortOffset.description: Offset from the CDP endpoint port for Bridgewright's internal tunnel port.

bridgewright.edgeUserDataDir.description: Windows Edge user data directory to use for Bridgewright's default profile. Leave empty to use Bridgewright's dedicated durable automation profile.

bridgewright.useSystemEdgeUserDataDirByD.description: Compatibility switch. When edgeUserDataDir is empty, use the permanent Edge profile root at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Edge\User Data instead of Bridgewright's dedicated default automation profile.

bridgewright.connectorPoolSize.description: Number of idle local tunnel connectors Bridgewright keeps ready for incoming Codespace CDP connections.

bridgewright.closeNamedProfilesOnDisconn.description: Close and remove non-default profile browser state when the final profile-scoped CDP connection disconnects. Disable to keep named profile windows alive until /profiles/<name>/close or /remove is called.

bridgewright.closeDefaultProfileOnDiscon.description: Close the default profile browser window when the final root CDP connection disconnects. The default profile data remains durable.
